kv6.10:1.3: rūpaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ rūpadhātu nīlaṃ pītakaṃ lohitakaṃ odātaṃ cakkhuviññeyyaṃ cakkhusmiṃ paṭihaññati cakkhussa āpāthaṃ āgacchatīti.
kv6.10:3.6: cakkhuñca paṭicca rūpe ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇanti
kv6.10:3.9: hañci cakkhuñca paṭicca rūpe ca uppajjati cakkhu viññāṇanti
kv6.10:3.10: attheva suttanto no vata re vattabbe
kv6.10:4.4: nanu passasi abhikkamantaṃ paṭikkamantaṃ ālokentaṃ vilokentaṃ sammiñjentaṃ pasārentanti.
kv6.10:4.6: hañci passasi abhikkamantaṃ paṭikkamantaṃ ālokentaṃ vilokentaṃ sammiñjentaṃ pasārentaṃ tena vata re vattabbe
kv6.10:4.8: kāyakammaṃ sanidassanantikathā. paṭhavīdhātu sanidassanātiādiṃ katvā kāyakammaṃ sanidassananti pariyosānakathā.
kv6.10:5.1: niyāmo asaṅkhato paṭiccasamuppādo asaṅkhato cattāri saccāni asaṅkhatāni cattāro āruppā asaṅkhatā nirodha samāpatti asaṅkhatā ākāso asaṅkhato ākāso sanidassano cattāro mahābhūtā pañcindriyāni tatheva kāyakammanti.
